last_result.headline: N3: multi-scale decomposition CLOSED as a remedy - no level exceeds G3.2 0.7242, the raw band is best (0.7160), AUC falls monotonically with coarser scale, and NCC is at chance in all 9 bands. The diagnostic instead located the real lever: narrowing the typewell window from 17ft to 3ft raises held-out-WELL AUC 0.7300 -> 0.7655 (8.7x seed noise) and the NO-TRAINING level score 0.6450 -> 0.7352, above G3.2 trained 0.7242. New protocol rule: scorer comparisons must split by WELL, not by pair.
